menu.tagline: One company from field to counter. Profit is everything… isn't it?
menu.footer: Burgrix is a satire; its company, people and events are made up.
hud.money.hint: The company's cash. Below minus 30,000 means bankruptcy.
hint.farm: Tap a plot to start a pasture, sow soy or sell it.
hint.feedlot: Tap the cows, the feed silo and the additive shelf.
hint.restaurant: Tap the grills and the registers to manage the crew.
hint.office: Posters are adverts, the board holds contacts; the corner screen has the reports.
plot.forest.text: Old trees. Cut them for room and the ecologists get angry.
plot.village.text: A few families live here. Their land looks very fertile…
plot.empty.text: Unused soil rests a little every month.
plot.grain.text: The town gets its bread from this field.
plot.grain.locked: The town's field. You can't touch it without a deal with the mayor.
plot.pasture.text: Calves grow up here, then move to the feedlot.
plot.soy.text: Sends feed to the feedlot silo in summer.
plot.desert.text: The soil is spent. Nothing will grow here again.
act.clearPasture: Cut the forest for a pasture
act.burnPasture: Burn the village for a pasture
act.takePasture: Take the field for a pasture
act.gm.note: {n} a month, bigger yields, but consumers and cows don't like it
act.badge.note: once; it might cheer them up
act.warn.note: once; the union will hear of it
act.fire.note: the queue leaves and the union gets angry
town.title: Town
town.content: The town is fed and happy
town.short: Bread is getting short in town
town.hungry: The town is hungry and restless
town.bribed: the mayor is on our side
town.notBribed: the mayor guards the town's fields
town.deserted.title: The town has emptied
town.deserted.text: When the wheat fields were gone, the people left too. Only the wind walks the streets now, and the boycotters are many more.
sea.title: The sea and the polar ice
sea.text: Ice {ice}%, the sea at mark {level}. Fewer forests, faster warming.
silo.title: Feed silo
silo.text: {n} / {max} units. Every cow eats 30 units a month.
shed.title: Slaughterhouse
shed.text: {q} patties waiting, {n} on the belt to the restaurant.
alert.restaurant.lowMorale: the crew's morale is on the floor
alert.restaurant.needGrills: long queues, the grills can't keep up
additive.meal.text: Every slaughtered cow gives feed back to the silo. Free, but it brings the risk of mad cow disease.
additive.hormones.text: Cows put on weight faster; illness is more likely too.
additive.waste.text: Spread on the soy fields as fertiliser: bigger yields, cows fall ill more easily.
cow.text: {kg} kg, +{gain} kg a month. Ready at {max} kg.
cow.names: Daisy, Clover, Buttercup, Cocoa, Caramel, Hazel, Fudge, Cinnamon, Cloudy, Olive, Maize, Peanut, Cherry, Mint, Button, Lilac, Smokey, Chestnut, Dove, Shamrock, Almond, Tulip, Ginger, Poppy, Custard, Treacle, Muffin, Berry, Violet, Domino, Quince, Laurel, Pippin, Honey, Wafer, Chubby, Cream, Pretzel, Walnut, Apple
fridge.title: Patty fridge
fridge.text: {n} / {max} patties. {b} burgers ready on the pass.
office.lobby.text: {n} contacts at work. They calm the critics down.
office.stats.text: Cash chart, monthly balance sheet and the critics.
camp.kids.text: Children's parties at the restaurant. Families pour in; anti-globalists are not amused.
camp.pyramid.text: A leaflet that puts the burger at the top of the food pyramid. Brings customers and softens the obesity lawsuits.
camp.charity.text: A few burgers are donated each time, with cameras ready. Customers come, criticism goes quiet.
camp.toons.text: The heroes of a popular cartoon on the menu. The most expensive, and it brings the most customers.
camp.politician.text: Speaks for us in parliament. Calms the anti-globalists and the unions.
camp.climatologist.text: Writes reports saying warming is not so bad after all. The ecologists settle down.
camp.nutritionist.text: Says on TV that a burger is a balanced meal. Fewer obesity lawsuits.
camp.inspector.text: Inspections always fall on a bank holiday. Consumer groups lower their voices.
warn.ecologists.title: Tree huggers
warn.ecologists.text: Ecologists are sharing photos of the felled forests and the tired soil. Going easy on nature for a while might help.
warn.globalists.title: Banners at the door
warn.globalists.text: Anti-globalists have started gathering outside the restaurant. Be careful with the villages and the town.
warn.consumers.title: Consumers ask questions
warn.consumers.text: Consumer groups wonder what goes into the patties. Ill cows and GM fields draw attention.
warn.unions.title: Grumbling in the kitchen
warn.unions.text: The union rep is upset about the warnings and the firings. Push a little harder and there'll be a strike.
warn.obesity.title: Waistlines are growing
warn.obesity.text: Lawyers are taking an interest in our customers' weight. You can act before they sue.
protest.ecologists.title: Ecologists boycott us
protest.ecologists.text: Ecologists asked the public to stay away. Fewer customers will come for {n} months.
protest.globalists.title: The big boycott
protest.globalists.text: Anti-globalists chained the door shut. Fewer customers will come for {n} months.
protest.consumers.title: Food poisoning case
protest.consumers.text: A consumer group won in court. The company paid {fine} in damages.
protest.unions.title: Strike!
protest.unions.text: The crew took off their aprons. Nobody will come to the restaurant for {n} months.
protest.obesity.title: Obesity lawsuit
protest.obesity.text: A customer blamed us for their weight and won. The company paid {fine}.
board.title: The board is restless
board.text: The board complains that the company isn't growing. They expect a profit of at least {n} every month.
red.title: Cash in the red
red.text: The bank has stopped answering the phone. If cash drops to {n}, the company goes bankrupt.
intro.farm.title: Fields
intro.farm.text: It all starts in the soil. Calves grow on the pastures, soy fields fill the silo in summer. Forests and villages are there to make room… at a price.
intro.feedlot.title: Feedlot
intro.feedlot.text: Cows put on weight here and become patties once they are heavy enough. The lamps on the shelf show which additives are on.
intro.restaurant.title: Restaurant
intro.restaurant.text: Cooks turn patties into burgers, cashiers turn burgers into money. An unhappy crew yawns; long queues send customers away.
intro.office.title: Head office
intro.office.text: Adverts bring customers, contacts calm the critics. The board wants more profit every month; the reports are on the corner screen.
help.title: How to play
help.1.title: A burger empire
help.1.text: You run the fields, the feedlot, the restaurant and the head office at once. The clock moves on every week; at month end income and costs hit the cash. If cash drops to minus 30,000, the game is over.
help.2.title: Fields
help.2.text: Pastures raise calves, soy fields give feed when summer comes. Tired soil turns to desert. Cutting forests and burning villages is cheap, but it angers the critics.
help.3.title: Feedlot
help.3.text: With an empty silo the cows lose weight. Hormones, industrial waste and animal meal speed things up but bring illness. Selling sick meat gets the consumers on their feet.
help.4.title: Restaurant
help.4.text: Every grill needs a cook and every register a cashier. When morale drops, give a badge or a warning; firing angers the union.
help.5.title: Head office
help.5.text: Adverts bring more customers, contacts silence the critics. The board's monthly target rises every year; the chart and the balance sheets are on the corner screen.
help.6.title: Critics
help.6.text: Five groups are watching you. Halfway out of patience they warn you; when it runs out, strikes, boycotts or lawsuits follow. A lit sign on the windows at the top means trouble in that sector.
pause.title: Break
over.title: Bankrupt
over.text: The cash hit rock bottom and the board took back the keys. The Burgrix sign came down.
